CL-IS-17526-2021-4.2.1.text: All stainless steel components that come into direct contact with beverage shall be manufactured from Grade 304 stainless steel conforming to IS 6911. Carbon content shall not exceed 0.08 percent.
CL-IS-17526-2021-4.2.1.requirement_text: All stainless steel components that come into direct contact with beverage shall be manufactured from Grade 304 stainless steel conforming to IS 6911. Carbon content shall not exceed 0.08 percent.

CL-IS-17526-2021-4.2.2.text: Polymeric parts in contact with beverage shall comply with overall migration limits specified in IS 9845 and shall be BPA-free food grade material.
CL-IS-17526-2021-4.2.2.requirement_text: Polymeric parts in contact with beverage shall comply with overall migration limits specified in IS 9845 and shall be BPA-free food grade material.

CL-IS-17526-2021-5.2.text: The filled and stoppered flask shall be inverted and held inverted for a period of 10 minutes at ambient temperature. There shall be no leakage or seepage of liquid.
CL-IS-17526-2021-5.2.requirement_text: The filled and stoppered flask shall be inverted and held inverted for a period of 10 minutes at ambient temperature. There shall be no leakage or seepage of liquid.

CL-IS-17526-2021-5.4.text: The flask filled with boiling water at 95°C and kept closed at 27±2°C ambient for 6 hours shall retain water temperature of not less than 60°C for capacities above 500ml.
CL-IS-17526-2021-5.4.requirement_text: The flask filled with boiling water at 95°C and kept closed at 27±2°C ambient for 6 hours shall retain water temperature of not less than 60°C for capacities above 500ml.
CL-IS-17526-2021-5.4.test_method: 6-hour temperature retention measurement with calibrated thermometer

CL-IS-17526-2021-7.1.text: Each flask shall be legibly and indelibly marked with: manufacturer name or trademark, nominal capacity in ml, year of manufacture, and Standard Mark (ISI Mark) under valid BIS license.
